description: Several pictures in one, in the order given (a JPEG named after the first). Takes image files. One result from all the files, in the order given.

CollageLayout.description: How the pictures of a collage are laid out.

oneOf.description: The first picture large on the left, the others stacked on the right.

columns.description: Columns of the grid; 2, or 3 for more than four pictures, when left out.

corners.description: Corner radius of each picture, in pixels.

layout.description: How the pictures are laid out.

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

spacing.description: Space between and around the pictures, in pixels.

whole.description: Show each picture whole, with background around it, instead of filling its cell.

width.description: Width of the result in pixels.
